q: The Furstenberg structure theorem for distal systems states that every minimal distal system is:
opts: An isometric extension of a point
A transfinite tower of isometric extensions (each stage is an isometric extension of the previous)
exp: Furstenberg (1963): every minimal distal flow is built as a (possibly transfinite) tower of isometric extensions, starting from a point. Each isometric extension adds a compact group fiber with isometric action. This completely characterises distal systems.
